issues.problem: Microsoft's FY2024 operating income was about $109.4 billion. $88.5 billion was the FY2023 figure.

data.summary: Revenue ($245.1B, +15.7% from $211.9B), net income ($88.1B), total assets ($512.2B) and cash ($18.3B) are correct. Operating income is wrong: it should be about $109.4B, and $88.5B is the FY2023 number. The note saying all figures were pre-verified was not taken as proof; each figure was checked.
